items.title: Jimmy and Jeannie Cheatham interviewed by Monk Rowe, San Diego, California, February 12, 1998
items.q: When Lockjaw flew in from Las Vegas, and they were all, we were getting the stuff together in the studio and he came in.

ctx.x: Because oh they’d try to figure that out. They’d call and say well so-and-so, and who’s the guest artist? They’d try to get you to slip up.
But we wouldn’t tell them. When Lockjaw flew in from Las Vegas, and they were all, we were getting the stuff together in the studio and he came in. He said, “Gentlemen.” And they’re ahhhh.
That’s a great way to make people come to work too, man.
